2. The Petitioner in this writ petition prays for the following relief:-
"In the facts and under the circumstances stated above, the Hon'ble Court would graciously be pleased to direct the 0pp. Parties, more particularly, the O.P. no.2 to:

i) provide a copy of award of compensation along with rate and valuation of the land and trees of the Petitioner acquired by the Railways and determined U/s.20-F(1) of the Railways Act, 1989 pursuant to Notification dated 19/08/2024 under Annexure-4 and,
ii) Provide details of the Arbitrator appointed by the Central Government in terms of the provisions U/s.20- F(6) of the Railways Act enabling the Petitioner to invoke arbitration.
Issue any appropriate order/orders deemed fit in the fact and circumstances of the case."

sentences.text: Mr. Padhy, learned Counsel for the Petitioner submits that the dispute in this writ petition hinges around inaction of the Railway Authority in appointing an arbitrator to determine the compensation for land acquisition.

He refers to the Affidavit filed on behalf of Opposite Party No.3-the Collector and District Magistrate, Sundargarh stating that the Collector and District Magistrate, Sundargarh has been recommended to be the arbitrator, to take a decision in the matter of grant of compensation.

4. Mrs. Das, learned Central Government Counsel on instruction submits that the Collector,
Jharsuguda and Collector, Sundargarh have already been appointed as the arbitrator for Double Line Flyover including Jharsuguda yard modification (26 Km.) in Jharsuguda district and for 07 Lines Loading Bulb at Barpali (47.7 Km.) in Sundargarh district respectively, vide letter No.33448 dated 8th September, 2025 issued by the Additional Secretary to Government, Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha, Bhubaneswar.

5. In view of the above, the Collector and District Magistrate, Sundargarh-Opposite Party No.3 is directed to issue notice to the parties forthwith and take up the matter for determination of compensation.
6. Mr. Dash, learned Additional Standing Counsel shall communicate this order to the Collector and District Magistrate, Sundargarh forthwith.
7. Written instruction Imparted to Mrs. Das, learned Central Government Counsel is taken on record.
8. Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid observation and direction.
